stories.title: Takeaways and analysis from Valkyries' sweep
Valkyries make 'history,' oust Aces to reach Finals in 2nd year as franchise
stories.summary: The second-year Valkyries became the quickest expansion team to reach the WNBA Finals, sweeping the defending champion Aces 87-77 in overtime Friday night in Game 3.

stories.title: Reese says 'job is not done' as Dream sweep Liberty to reach WNBA Finals
stories.summary: Angel Reese had 22 points, and the Dream finished the Liberty with an 85-83 win in Game 3 to advance to the WNBA Finals for the first time since 2013.

stories.title: Norvell shoulders blame as FSU authors another 'extremely poor performance'
stories.summary: After Florida State rushed to a 14-0 advantage, Louisville rallied to take down the struggling Seminoles 44-20 on Friday night, increasing the pressure on embattled coach Mike Norvell, who told reporters that it was "an extremely poor performance by us."

stories.title: RB Barkley, WR Smith among 5 Eagles ruled out for London game vs. Jags
stories.summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.
